div.head: II Cn 70.1
div.ab: Ac beo be his dihte seo æht gescyft swyðe rihte wife ⁊ cildum ⁊ nehmagum, ælcum be þære mæðe, þe him to gebyrige.
Ac beo be his dihte seo æht gescyft swiðe rihte wife ⁊ cildan ⁊ nehmagon, ælcum be þære mæðe, þe him to gebyrige.
Sed sit secundum dictionem eius ipsa pecunia recte diuisa uxori, pueris, propinquis, unicuique secundum modum, qui ad eum pertinet.
Ac beo be his dihte seo æht gescyft swyðe rihte wife ⁊ cildan ⁊ neahmagon, ælcon be ðære mæðe ðe him to gebyrige.
Ac beo be his dihte, seo æht gescyft swyðe rihte wife and cildum and nehmagum, ælcum be þære mæðe, þe him to gebyrige.
Vielmehr werde unter seiner Anordnung die Habe höchst gerecht vertheilt an Ehefrau und Kinder und nahe Verwandte, jedem nach dem Maass, das ihm gebührt.
Rather, let the property be distributed, under his direction, most justly to wife and children and near kinsmen, to each according to the measure that is due to him.
But, according to his direction, the property shall be very strictly divided among his wife and children and near kinsmen, each according to the share which belongs to him.
But by his direction, the property is to be very justly divided among the wife, the children and the close kinsmen, each in the proportion which belongs to him.
But under his direction, the estate shall be divided most fairly among his wife, children, and close relatives, each receiving the share appropriate for them.
